notes: The oath *as thy soul liveth* is read by rule 55: *as ... liveth* to חַי, discontinuous under rule 25, with the noun and suffix keeping their own English.
The attributive article takes the relative *that* (rule 41); בָּזֶה fuses into the single *here*, headed on the demonstrative, which carries the content (rules 23, 30).
The לְ before the gerund is unrepresented, the ASV writing no word for it (rules 40, 52).
